verdict.rationale: Drata publishes a public APIv2 reference at developers.drata.com/openapi/reference/v2, generated from OpenAPI and organized by tag, with endpoint pages for Personnel, Controls, Policies, Devices and more. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive (try-it console) or includes runnable examples, and probes for a downloadable OpenAPI spec at common paths returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it functionality, runnable request/response examples, a downloadable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
